[Find the right product for you][40]

Benefiting from our vertical integration - ranging from membrane electrode assembly (MEA) bipolar
plates and stack design to complete system integration - Ballard's fuel cell products deliver proven
durability, reliability, and high power density with the lowest total cost of ownership.

## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

###### Promise

## Customer support, when and where you need it most

As much as we’re a technology company, we are, first and foremost, here for our customers. We work
hard to understand the challenges you face and anticipate your needs. From the design validation
phase to system integration and after-sales support, we’re your partner in success. *Here for Life™*

[Customer Support][51]

[Customer Support][Customer Support]

## Clean power for the future

*Here for Life™* is the central pillar of our purpose. It signifies our recognition that
zero-emission power is imperative and the global transition to clean and secure energy is underway.
We are ready to play a pivotal role as a trusted partner, supporting the critical decarbonization
and energy security efforts of our customers, governments, and local communities.

[Our Sustainability][52]

[Clean power for the future]

Fuel Cell Stack

## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

###### Promise

## Customer support, when and where you need it most

As much as we’re a technology company, we are, first and foremost, here for our customers. We work
hard to understand the challenges you face and anticipate your needs. From the design validation
phase to system integration and after-sales support, we’re your partner in success. *Here for Life™*

[Customer Support][51]

[Customer Support][Customer Support]

## Clean power for the future

*Here for Life™* is the central pillar of our purpose. It signifies our recognition that
zero-emission power is imperative and the global transition to clean and secure energy is underway.
We are ready to play a pivotal role as a trusted partner, supporting the critical decarbonization
and energy security efforts of our customers, governments, and local communities.

# **Fortschritt Tanken mit Wasserstoff**

Der Energieträger Wasserstoff (H2) ist bereits heute in der Mobilität alltagstauglich. Vor allem im
Transportsektor ist Wasserstoff eine emissionsfreie Alternative mit kurzer Betankungszeit und hoher
Reichweite, ohne Einschränkung bei der Nutzlast.

Wir sind Ihr Partner für maßgeschneiderte Tankstellenlösungen – mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung
und einem umfangreichen Leistungsangebot.

## **
## 
## Mit Wasserstoff bewegen wir gemeinsam Großes**







[

### Auf Wasserstoff umsteigen und Vorteile sichern

Unser H2-Tankstellennetz bildet das Fundament für die Mobilität Ihrer leistungsfähigen
Wasserstoff-Fahrzeugflotte. Wir unterstützen Sie bei einem erfolgreichen Umstieg auf H2.
Weiterlesen
][25]

### Wir entwickeln, bauen und betreiben Ihre Wasserstoff­­tankstelle

die Standortbewertung, Planung, Bau und Betrieb für Ihre H2-Station umfassen.

Decarbonize your business with advanced zero-emissions technologies that deliver reliable,
sustainable power.

[European zero-emissions truck cab]

Plug is proud to offer its customers industry-leading electrolyzer products and affordable hydrogen,
which is quickly becoming the molecule of choice for customers both large and small.

## Transport Hydrogen

Plug offers trailer solutions to transport hydrogen from production plants to users around the world

integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

## **Resilient Energy Solutions**
## EFOY Fuel Cell vs. Generator

Compared to conventional generators, fuel cell technology provides a cleaner, quieter, and more
resilient energy solution. Designed for continuous, autonomous operation, fuel cells deliver
reliable off-grid power without moving parts, frequent maintenance, or high noise levels — making
them the smarter alternative for mission-critical applications.

## **ISO-certified** company

SFC Energy is certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001. Since as far back as 2005, we have been working
with a quality management system compliant with DIN ISO 9001, regularly reviewing our processes and
investing in new technology in order to continuously develop ourselves.

[Quality & environmental guidelines][102]

## Trust the **market leader**

With thousands of fuel cells sold, SFC Energy has successfully established its fully commercialised
and multi-award-winning products on the global market for over 20 years. The company also develops,
produces and markets high-performance electronics components such as voltage transformers and
switching power supplies on an international basis for the industry sector in particular with equal
success. Its products are increasingly being supplied as system solutions for power supplies in
accordance with customers’ needs.

## From Germany to the **world**

Solutions from the SFC Energy are used all over the world – from Singapore to the Antarctic. Our
power solutions provide electrical energy for measuring and early warning stations, defense
applications, traffic monitoring systems, mobile homes, yachts, and much more.

## SFC Energy AG
## **worldwide**

SFC Energy AG is an international technology leader, providing reliable energy for critical
infrastructure and applications beyond the grid. Focusing on resilient energy and power management
solutions, the company serves high-growth markets in security, defense, infrastructure, IT and
high-tech industrial equipment.

As a pioneer in fuel cell technology, SFC Energy offers innovative hybrid energy systems and high
precision power management solutions for stationary and portable applications worldwide. The
company’s products are engineered to provide energy-efficient solutions, delivering optimized total
cost of ownership (TCO) across its two strategic business segments as: Clean Energy and Clean Power
Management.

Headquartered in Brunnthal near Munich, Germany, SFC Energy has international subsidiaries in
Canada, Denmark, India, the Netherlands, Romania, the United Kingdom, and the United States of
America. Its international presence enables close proximity to core target markets and customers
worldwide.

SFC Energy AG is listed in the Prime Standard segment of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and has been
part of the selection index SDAX since 2022 [(GSIN: 756857 ISIN: DE0007568578)][103].

car buying guides, comprehensive car comparison analyses, and authentic vehicle ownership
experiences. Whether you are looking for a fuel-efficient family hatchback, a rugged multi-terrain
SUV, a premium executive sedan, or a heavy-duty pickup truck, our unbiased performance evaluations
are designed to empower consumers worldwide to make smarter, highly informed automotive decisions.

The transition to sustainable transportation is moving at an unprecedented pace, and electric
vehicles (EVs) are at the forefront of this industrial revolution. AutoTorque delivers comprehensive
EV industry insights, monitoring the latest electric car launches, breakthrough next-gen solid-state
battery technology, and international charging infrastructure development. We keep a close eye on
market trends, offering critical analyses of legacy automakers as they pivot toward complete
electrification, alongside deep dives into emerging EV startups that are disrupting traditional
manufacturing models with zero-emission innovations.

For those who prefer life on two wheels, AutoTorque boasts an expansive motorcycle news and review
section. Our riding impressions capture the raw dynamics of the latest two-wheeler innovations from
around the globe. We cater to every segment of the riding community, featuring detailed breakdowns
of daily commuter motorcycles, adventure bikes built for overland touring, classic cruisers, and
track-ready sportbikes. Our coverage ensures you stay updated on global emissions standards,
motorcycle engineering advancements, and safety gear innovations.

Modern vehicles are no longer just mechanical transport machines; they are sophisticated data
centers on wheels. Automotive technology continues to evolve exponentially, reshaping our entire
driving experience. AutoTorque investigates the modern software-defined vehicle, bringing you the
latest updates on connected car technology, autonomous driving systems (including Level 3 and Level
4 autonomy), artificial intelligence in automotive design, advanced driver assistance systems
(ADAS), and next-generation infotainment setups powered by seamless Over-the-Air (OTA) updates.

Understanding the future of transportation requires an analytical lens on corporate and regulatory
shifts. AutoTorque provides on-the-ground reporting from major international auto shows—including
Geneva, Detroit, Tokyo, and Munich—giving our readers an exclusive preview of concept vehicles and
advanced design studies. We analyze how top-tier global automakers are adjusting their production
pipelines to meet shifting consumer demands, volatile supply chains, and stringent environmental
regulations enforced by governments worldwide.

We believe that an informed car buyer is a smart consumer. Beyond technological innovation,
AutoTorque offers invaluable practical resources for individuals looking to purchase their next
vehicle. From breakdown metrics of vehicle specifications to dissecting global auto financing
options, car leasing trends, and long-term vehicle maintenance costs, our platform serves as a
complete automotive encyclopedia. Our mission is rooted in editorial integrity, ensuring that our
global readership receives factual, reliable information and expert insights when it matters most.

Looking beyond standard ownership models, next-generation future mobility ecosystems are completely
transforming the traditional urban transit landscape. AutoTorque closely monitors the rapid
expansion of shared mobility networks, smart city integration, vehicle-to-everything (V2X)
communication infrastructure, and alternative green energy powertrains like hydrogen fuel cells. By
exploring these macro-trends, we provide a holistic view of how society will commute, travel, and
manage commercial logistics in the upcoming decades.

Whether you are a hardcore petrolhead, an eco-conscious EV adopter, an automotive industry analyst,
or a first-time car buyer trying to make sense of a crowded marketplace, AutoTorque curates premium
content tailored specifically for you. The automotive ecosystem is shifting faster than ever before,
and our global platform is built to ensure you never miss a beat. We filter out the noise to deliver
meaningful perspectives that keep you well ahead of the curve.

From breaking global automotive news alerts and hyper-detailed track testing to independent EV
analysis and predictive future mobility trend mapping, AutoTorque remains unyielding in its
commitment to world-class automotive journalism. We look forward to being your trusted co-driver on
this exciting journey through the fast lane of global automotive innovation. Stay tuned, stay
informed, and drive the future with AutoTorque.

## About Us

Ningbo VET Energy Technology Co., Ltd is the Energy department of VET Group, which is a national
high-tech enterprise specializing in the research and development, production, sales and service of
fuel cell parts, such as hydrogen fuel cell stack, hydrogen generator, membrane electrode assembly,
bipolar plate, PEM electrolyzer, fuel cell system, catalyst, BOP part, and additional accessories.
VET Energy is one of the prominent Chinese manufacturers and suppliers of hydrogen fuel cells,
vanadium batteries, proton exchange membrane batteries and related accessories. We adhere to the
principle of quality orientation and customer priority to provide our customers with superior
quality and excellent prices for hydrogen fuel cells, vanadium batteries, proton exchange membrane
batteries and related accessories. We heartily welcome your letters, phone calls and inquiries for
business cooperation.

Ningbo VET Energy Technology Co., Ltd is the Energy department of VET Group, which is a national
high-tech enterprise specializing in the research and development, production, sales and service of
fuel cell parts, such as hydrogen fuel cell stack, hydrogen generator, membrane electrode assembly,
bipolar plate, PEM electrolyzer, fuel cell system, catalyst, BOP part, and additional accessories.

vanadium batteries, proton exchange membrane batteries and related accessories. We adhere to the

# Fuel cell systems and electrolysers for decarbonising energy

Convion Ltd. is a leading fuel cell system developer commercializing solid oxide fuel cell systems
for distributed power generation in industrial and commercial applications. Our products are
designed for premium energy efficiency, reliability and operational flexibility. As a part of HD
Hydrogen, Convion provides its global customers with sustainable power generation solutions for
power security, energy independence and unparalleled fuel economy

Convion’s mission is to support  sustainable energy transition with high temperature electrochemical
solutions based on solid oxide cell (SOC) technology. Solid oxide fuel cells at the heart of our
power generating products are ideal for distributed and small scale power generation. They make
possible clean, dependable power generation at superb electrical efficiency at any scale, and
co-locating zero local emission power generation with consumption. Convion’s proven, proprietary
system technology facilitates broad fuel flexibility with no compromise in efficiency. In hydrogen
production, solid oxide electrolysis by Convion’s technology offers unparalleled efficiency and
scalability to meet industrial demand.
